steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for this case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publishing.
Provide the required event title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ event.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the RFQ line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the required 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the bid.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's separate supplier portal session.
Open the technical stage first to verify RFQ-only terms are not shown there.
Confirm the payment clause does not appear on the technical stage.
Confirm the delivery clause does not appear on the technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the mandatory terms should be presented.
Confirm the vendor can read the payment clause on the RFQ stage.
Confirm the vendor can read the delivery clause on the RFQ stage.
Accept the mandatory payment clause.
Accept the mandatory delivery clause.
Submit the vendor's quote after accepting both mandatory clauses.
Assert that the vendor bid was submitted successfully.
Return to the buyer's event page.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Confirm the buyer sees the acceptance status for the submitted bid.
